mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 49 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a full moon phase. The overnight low will be 46 degrees with no rain predicted, and the ISS is passing overhead tonight, though you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is inviting residents to share feedback on the US 18/151 Corridor Study. There are two opportunities to participate, including an in-person meeting on November 18 at Mount Horeb High School and a virtual meeting on November 19, both starting at 5:30 p.m.

We have a busy week ahead starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, followed by more trivia and live music throughout the week and our annual Main Street Trick or Treat this Wednesday.

In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel and arrested him for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day was Pumpkin Pecan. The restaurant is currently closed for the night, but we will be back tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM serving up the Chocolate Caramel Twist.
